summary: OneMain Holdings, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting entry into an underwriting agreement for a $600.0 million public offering of 7.125% Senior Notes due 2034 by its subsidiary OneMain Finance Corporation, guaranteed by OMH. The offering is expected to close August 20, 2026, with proceeds for general corporate purposes, possibly debt repurchases. This is a routine debt capital markets transaction, not a special situation. Watch for customary closing conditions; no special-situation angle.
